description:
Submission of details of an enhanced sound insulation value DnT,w and L'nT,w of at least 5dB above the Building Regulations value, for the floor/ceiling/wall structures separating different types of rooms/ uses in adjoining dwellings pursuant to condition 5; an enhanced sound insulation value DnT,w of at least 10dB above the Building Regulations value, for the floodwall structures separating the commercial part of the premises from the proposed residential unit, and, where necessary, additional mitigation measures are implemented to contain commercial noise within the commercial premises and to achieve the criteria of BS8233:2014 within the dwellings/ noise sensitive premises pursuant to condition 6; cycle
storage fixtures/fittings to serve the areas shown for this purpose on the approved plans pursuant to condition 7; refuse storage and a waste management plan pursuant to condition 8; Construction Logistics Plan pursuant to condition 9; Construction               Management Plan pursuant to condition 10; Ventilation Strategy Report to mitigate the  impact Of existing poor air quality for the self-contained dwellinghouse pursuant to condition 12; of the installed Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP), Heat Battery Boiler,
Electric Boilers or alternative electrical only heating systems (Class C3) pursuant to condition 14 of planning permission ref: 2026/00081/FUL granted 21st October 2026.
